title: Brent +3% spike reverses into CCL
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Brent daily log return above +3 pct is over-extrapolated into cruise names and partially reverses (+); trade long CCL 4d at 3d lag [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.CCL.log_return]
message: Not supported: Brent +3pct spikes do not reverse into CCL; contemporaneous r=-0.30 (perm p=0.018) but lag 1-4 r~0; long-CCL rule 50 trades, hit 48pct, excess -0.45pct, sharpe -0.94, OOS hit 37.5pct; actionability 0.3

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.BZ=F.log_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long CCL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Brent log-return spikes hit cruise names contemporaneously (r=-0.30 at lag 0) with no reversal at 1-4d; test whether the drop continues: trade short CCL 2d at 1d lag (-) [finance.BZ=F.log_return -> finance.CCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0075)
